accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the project account: the platform gas sponsor, or the producer themself.

accounts.name: producer_usdc
docs: Producer's USDC account that pays the mint fee; the producer signs the transfer.

accounts.name: investor_instrument
docs: The investor's Instrument account in this pool, if they ever subscribed to it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the Instrument account: the platform gas sponsor, or the investor themself.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer does not hold the required role

errors.name: InvalidPremium
errors.msg: Premium must be between 500 and 600 bps

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: Subscription close must be in the future and before maturity

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ProjectAlreadyInPool
errors.msg: Project is already in a pool

errors.name: ProjectNotInPool
errors.msg: Project is not in this pool

errors.name: CropMismatch
errors.msg: Project crop or season does not match the pool

errors.name: ProjectLocked
errors.msg: Fields cannot change after the project joins a pool

errors.name: FieldMismatch
errors.msg: Field does not belong to this project

errors.name: NotAllDisbursed
errors.msg: Every project must be disbursed before redemption funding

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee is above the allowed cap

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury account is not the fee treasury's USDC account

errors.name: MissingFeeAccount
errors.msg: A fee is due but its accounts were not provided

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Platform fee settings. Singleton PDA `["fees"]`, controlled by `Config.admin`.
Fees are charged only while this account exists; old deployments without it charge nothing.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives every fee; fees land in its USDC associated token account.

fields.name: network_fee
docs: USDC base units added to each subscription, paid by the investor.

fields.name: mint_fee
docs: USDC base units prepaid by the producer at `register_project`.

fields.name: max_arrangement_bps
docs: Upper bound for `PoolTerms.arrangement_fee_bps`, itself at most `MAX_ARRANGEMENT_BPS`.

types.name: PoolTerms
docs: Per-pool commercial terms, PDA `["terms", pool]`. Set by the Issuer while the pool is Draft.
A pool without this account (every pool created before fees) has a zero arrangement fee.

fields.name: arrangement_fee_bps
docs: Share of each project's requested amount withheld for the treasury at disbursement.

constants.name: MAX_ARRANGEMENT_BPS
docs: Hard ceiling for any pool's arrangement fee, whatever FeeConfig says (10%).

constants.name: MAX_MINT_FEE
docs: Hard ceiling for the project mint fee: 50 USDC.

constants.name: MAX_NETWORK_FEE
docs: Hard ceiling for the per-subscription network fee: 10 USDC.
